title: From Memory to Behavior: A Behavior-Aware Role-Playing Framework for Social Media Influencers
abstract: arXiv:2609.21349v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models have shown strong potential as role-playing agents for real individuals, yet faithful impersonating remains challenging. Existing in-context learning-based methods fail to capture how individuals react under different situations. In addition, LLM-based evaluation is difficult for obscure individuals. To address these challenges, we propose Situation--Internal state--Behavior Persona method to incorporate situation-dependent behavioral strategies. We further design an evaluation protocol that provides LLM evaluators with references about the impersonated individual. We evaluate our approach on a newly constructed dataset for the task of generating replies on social media. Experimental results show that our proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art ICL-based baselines, while our evaluation protocol achieves moderate correlation with human judgment. translated_title: 从记忆到行为：面向社交媒体网红的行为感知角色扮演框架
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型作为真实个体的角色扮演智能体展现出了强大的潜力，然而忠实地模仿仍然具有挑战性。现有的基于上下文学习（ICL）的方法无法捕捉个体在不同情境下的反应方式。此外，对于知名度较低的个体，基于LLM的评估也十分困难。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了情境--内部状态--行为人格（Situation--Internal state--Behavior Persona）方法，以纳入依赖情境的行为策略。我们进一步设计了一种评估协议，为LLM评估者提供关于被模仿个体的参考信息。我们在一个新构建的数据集上针对社交媒体回复生成任务评估了我们的方法。实验结果表明，我们提出的方法优于最先进的基于ICL的基线方法，同时我们的评估协议与人类判断达到了中等程度的相关性。此外，在虚构角色基准上的实验证明了……（原文摘要于此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出情境--内部状态--行为人格（SIB）方法，通过为角色扮演引入依赖情境的行为策略，显著提升大语言模型对真实个体（尤其是社交媒体网红）的忠实模仿能力，并设计了向LLM评估者提供被模仿个体参考信息的评估协议。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Situation--Internal state--Behavior Persona method that incorporates situation-dependent behavioral strategies to enable faithful role-playing of real individuals (social media influencers) with LLMs, together with an evaluation protocol that provides LLM evaluators with references about the impersonated individual.
